biggest_catch: There is a $0 annual fee, so the math is clean — but this is not a flat bonus. Discover matches the miles you earn in your first year, so the payout depends entirely on your year-one activity, and you wait up to a year plus two billing periods to see the match.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never overspend just to chase a bonus; buying things to hit a threshold wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on this.
Only new Discover cardholders qualify, and your account must remain open — a closed account forfeits the match.
The match period is the first 365 days or 12 billing cycles, whichever is longer; the match posts within two billing periods after it ends.
There is no minimum spending and no maximum on the match — but no earn means no match.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily dip your credit score by a few points.
The card's variable APR (around 20%+) will erase the entire bonus in a month or two if you carry a balance — pay the full statement balance every month.
